{{Quote|I'm trying to find someone to help me with a few things but between the art festivals and the debate everybody is busy. I'm trying to arrange some gatherings for those of us who don't really care which town is superior to the other.|Ajuva Vanasterin|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Ajuva Vanasterin''' was an individual responsible for giving out dinner invitations.

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Ajuva resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. She grew so tired of arguments between citizens of [[Restuss]] and [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] concerning which town was better, so she sought to organize a dinner party for those who wanted to just come together.

She tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with the responsibility of personally giving a dinner invitation to her close friend, [[Jinderliss Prason]]. The spacer carried out the task, and was paid several [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the trouble.

Before the [[Battle of Restuss]] erupted, Ajuva was apparently evacuated from the city by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ajuva Vanasterin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. She was removed from the game on [[June 27]], [[2006]], due to the new changes that were made to Restuss.
